entrypoints.attribution: attribution.attribute_packet(packet_dir, scored_statuses) -> {qid: {primary_cause, secondary_causes, evidence, row_evidence, llm_reviewer}}

drop_in_emission_module.dependencies: python3 stdlib only; the accepted classifier is imported READ-ONLY from the product mount

1_attribution_record.use: Names the primary cause of zero counter-label emission per bundle (e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT on all three v3 bundles) with byte-level evidence. Product appends this to its disclosure chain as the retrieval/emission-side cause named by the accepted BOUNDED-NEGATIVE verdict's cause #1.

2_emission_module.integration_point: product/query/pipeline.py enrich_query_bundle, BETWEEN adversarial_retrieval_pass() and apply_anchor_labels(): call promote_heuristic_proposals(audited, scored_statuses=SCORED_STATUSES) so the gate-passed heuristic proposals reach the accepted classifier as scored proposals.
2_emission_module.contract: The module is a pure function of (bundle bytes, repair spec). It never touches geometry, ranks, clusters, existing scored labels, the accepted classifier, or either frozen rubric. It writes counter_proposal_source='heuristic_proposal_promotion_v1' on every promoted row so the seam is auditable.
2_emission_module.safety: The accepted classifier remains the safety net: any proposal whose evidence fails the frozen emission gate becomes a COUNTED abstention (counter_status='abstained_unevidenced'), never a shipped label.

3_determinism_disclosure.use: Feeds Core Evaluation's open items 5/6 (FR counter-stage instability). The repaired emission path is byte-identical across 3 identical offline runs on all three bundles; the record is the determinism-or-disclosure response Product owes.

4_measurement_summary.use: The full before/after three-number publication (n_proposed/n_scored/n_emitted/n_abstained, support-among-issued, abstention count, yield, absolute-bar status as written) for Product's append-only intake (serve_verdict.py pattern).

what_evaluation_must_cross_check.input_hashes: Every hash in MEASUREMENT_SUMMARY.json input_hash_verification against the committed packet bytes.
what_evaluation_must_cross_check.classifier_config: classifier_hash_verification_before/after against the accepted d236f599 pins and RULES_LABEL.json sha256 4457e971df3dc5d10af2a727aa675afc15a15564c18eed4cede0af5eb41b4608.
what_evaluation_must_cross_check.absolute_bar: absolute_bar_status computed from the frozen rubric's own verdict_rule AS WRITTEN; NOT_APPLICABLE and NOT_MEASURED never a pass.
what_evaluation_must_cross_check.determinism: DETERMINISM.json identical=true on all three bundles with n_runs=3.
what_evaluation_must_cross_check.non_vacuity: NON_VACUITY.json seeded_control.pass and negative_control.pass both true.
what_evaluation_must_cross_check.support_among_issued: Published beside abstention count and yield in EMISSION.json; never a bare support rate.

invariants_this_team_never_breaks: The accepted classifier config (d236f599) is byte-identical before and after every measurement.
Both frozen rubrics (RULES_LABEL.json sha256 4457e971...) are byte-identical.
The frozen absolute bar 1.0 is computed AS WRITTEN and never re-derived or re-tuned.
No row's geometry (x, y, cluster_id, is_outlier, rank) is moved.
No assertion that any decision IS supporting/contrary/limiting is made anywhere.
Zero writes to product/, evaluation/, results/product/, results/evaluation/, state/product.json, state/evaluation.json, .github/**, or any frozen artifact.
human_gate_ready is never touched; no serve recommendation is produced; the accepted BOUNDED-NEGATIVE verdict of record stands.
promotion_rationale: The attribution names a primary cause (e_EMISSION_WRITER_ABORT) on all three v3 bundles. The minimal in-budget repair promotes the already gate-passed heuristic proposals into scored statuses, recovering n_scored>0 on all three bundles (8/8/4, up from 0/0/0). Determinism is proven (3 identical runs per bundle). The accepted classifier config and both frozen rubrics are re-verified byte-identical. The drop-in module, full three-number publication, and this integration contract are complete. The frozen absolute bar remains unmet as written (LABEL_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_POPULATION) and is never re-derived; the value of the measurement is the recovered, evidenced, deterministic issuance itself. The accepted classifier abstains honestly on the heuristic proposals under the frozen rubric (pivot_absent / no_intent_marker / no_domain_anchor), which is the correct fail-closed behavior and is published beside the abstention count and yield.
